newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Force to place 25 mln shrs at 75 NZc/shr.
newsitem.headline: Force to place 25 mln shrs at 75 NZc/shr.

text.p: Property development and cinema exhibition company Force Corporation said on Wednesday it would make a placement of 25 million fully paid ordinary shares at 75 NZ cents per share, subject to approval by a shareholders.
It said the monies raised will be used to fund future investment in the company's core business activities.
The New Zealand Stock Exchange had initially said the placement would be made at 25 cents per share, but the company confirmed the correct price as 75 cents.
